{"consolidated_memory":"FLAPPING FLAG IN PLATFORM/FEATUREFLAGS/EVAL.GO — FOUR SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: platform/featureflags/eval.go (platform side)
Stack: Go
Common signal across all incidents: decision alternates between calls
Common reproduction: evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly
Covering test: platform/featureflags/eval_test.go

---

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-13]
Trigger condition: Two requests raced on the same key
Root cause: Cache entry never invalidated on write
Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
PR #2314, branch fix/flapping-flag-1
Result: Reclaimed 7 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 2: [2026-02-01]
Trigger condition: Only appeared on staging read replica
Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
PR #7008, branch fix/flapping-flag-2
Result: Error rate dropped from 9.8 percent to under 1 per ten thousand (0.01%)

OCCASION 3: [2026-02-20]
Trigger condition: Only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
PR #8172, branch fix/flapping-flag-3
Result: Alert stayed quiet for 81 consecutive days

OCCASION 4: [2026-07-17]
Trigger condition: Only for records carrying non-ASCII names
Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialisation
Fix: Guarded the initialisation with a double-checked lock
PR #9574, branch fix/flapping-flag-4
Result: Throughput rose 25 percent to 761 requests per second"}
